title: OLIVE: View-Augmented Latent Prediction with Waveform Reconstruction for Speech SSL
abstract: arXiv:2606.30356v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose Online Latent prediction with Invariant Views and rEconstruction (OLIVE), a self-supervised speech representation learning framework that jointly optimizes analysis and synthesis objectives. OLIVE couples masked latent prediction and waveform reconstruction through a functional separation within a single encoder: reconstruction constrains early encoder features to retain signal-level information, while masked latent prediction shapes later contextual representations for robust downstream performance, with waveform view augmentations defining the invariances they learn. To the best of our knowledge, OLIVE is the first speech SSL model that directly reconstructs waveforms, retains its vocoder after pre-training, and remains competitive on discriminative tasks. Adding reconstruction largely preserves the speech recognition performance of masked latent prediction alone, while improving waveform reconstruction and speaker tasks

translated_title: OLIVE：基于视图增强的潜在预测与波形重建的语音自监督学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了在线潜在预测与不变视图及重建（OLIVE），这是一种联合优化分析与合成目标的自监督语音表征学习框架。OLIVE通过单一编码器内部的功能分离，将掩码潜在预测与波形重建耦合起来：重建任务约束编码器早期特征以保留信号级信息，而掩码潜在预测则塑造编码器后期的上下文表征以实现稳健的下游性能，波形视图增强定义了模型所学习的不变性。据我们所知，OLIVE是首个能够直接重建波形、在预训练后保留其声码器、并在判别类任务上保持竞争力的语音自监督学习模型。加入重建目标在很大程度上保留了仅使用掩码潜在预测时的语音识别性能，同时改善了波形重建质量和说话人相关任务的表现。
tldr: OLIVE是首个在单一编码器内通过功能分离联合掩码潜在预测与波形重建的语音自监督学习框架，在保持语音识别等判别任务竞争力的同时，可直接重建波形并提升说话人任务表现。
en_tdlr: OLIVE is the first speech SSL framework that couples masked latent prediction with waveform reconstruction through functional separation within a single encoder, remaining competitive on discriminative tasks while directly reconstructing waveforms and improving speaker tasks.
